'$'''echo "$({ echo "Level 2" & echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&' (841 us, 0.02%)

'$'\''diff <(while IFS= read -r line, do\n echo "$line" | tee >(sed \'\''s/.*/PROC1: &/\'\'' 1>&2) | { cat | while read -r x, do\n echo "$x" | tee >(wc -l 1>&2) | { awk \'\''{print "AWK:", $0}\'\'' | tee >(grep -v \'\''^$\'\'' 1>&2) & wait $! 2> /dev/null || true, },\' (11,402 us, 0.21%)
'dynamic_array["$(echo "$key" | md5sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"]="$(echo "Value for $key" | base64 & wait $!)" (&)' (499 us, 0.01%)

'$'''result=$({ echo "Level 1" & echo "$({ echo "Level 2" & echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" & wait 2> /dev/null
echo "Level 2 done"' (403 us, 0.01%)
'dynamic_array["$(echo "$key" | md5sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"]="$(echo "Value for $key" | base64 & wait $!)" (&)' (488 us, 0.01%)

'$'''tee >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch1: $n" 1>&2 &
done) >(while read -r n, do
 echo "Branch2: $n" 1>&2 &
done) (&)' (1,894 us, 0.03%)
'$'\''exec 8> >(while IFS= read -r line, do\n echo "FD8: $line" 1>&6,\ndone) (&)' (1,338 us, 0.02%)
'for key in $(echo "key1 key2 key3" | tr '\'' '\'' '\''\n'\'' | sort -R)' (143 us, 0.00%)
'for key in $(echo "key1 key2 key3" | tr '\'' '\'' '\''\n'\'' | sort -R)' (175 us, 0.00%)
'dynamic_array["$(echo "$key" | md5sum | cut -d'\'' '\'' -f1)"]="$(echo "Value for $key" | base64 & wait $!)" (&)' (584 us, 0.01%)
'$'\''echo "$({ echo "Level 3" & echo "$(echo "Level 4" & wait 2> /dev/null\necho "Level 4 done")" & wait 2> /dev/null\necho "Level 3 done", } & wait 2> /dev/null)" (&)' (724 us, 0.01%)
